```{r packages echo = FALSE}
library(readxl) # For reading in excel files
```


#Introduction

Gorgonian octocorals are important structural and suspension-feeding components of tropical coral reefs, yet baseline ecological data across many Western Indian Ocean reef systems remain sparse. This project builds on preliminary, unpublished Bachelor of Science with Honours field surveys conducted across reef sites in Mauritius and Rodrigues, where no prior quantitative baseline existed for these surveyed locations.

Originally, these dive survey logs, colony measurements, and water-column nutrient/chlorophyll-a records were stored in fragmented spreadsheets and analyzed through siloed, manual workflows. Here, that preliminary baseline dataset is migrated into a reproducible `tidyverse` pipeline in R and paired with Google Earth Engine (GEE) spatial oceanography (`HYCOM` surface current speed) to:

1. Characterize gorgonian abundance, coral cover, and colony morphometrics (height and width) across sites in Mauritius and Rodrigues;
2. Examine relationships between gorgonian patterns, water-column nutrients/chlorophyll-a, and regional current speed; and
3. Document a transparent methodological shift from manual, spreadsheet-based undergraduate analyses toward reproducible, code-driven marine data science.

# Creating clean_name function

```{r}
# Helper function to make column names clean snake_case 
clean_name <- function(df) {
  names(df) <- names(df) |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") |>
    str_remove_all("^_|_$")
  df
}
```


# Standardising

Applying clean_name function to all dataframes and standardising the island and site spelling across all tables

```{r}
dive_clean <- dive |>
  clean_name() |>
  mutate(
    island = str_squish(island),
    site   = str_squish(str_to_title(site)),
    site   = recode(site, "Seafan Valley" = "Sea Fan Valley")
  )

transect_clean <- transect |>
  clean_name() |>
  mutate(
    island = str_squish(island),
    site   = str_squish(str_to_title(site)),
    site   = recode(site, "Seafan Valley" = "Sea Fan Valley")
  )

nutrients_clean <- nutrient_data |>
  clean_name() |>
  mutate(
    island = str_squish(island),
    site   = str_squish(str_to_title(site)),
    site   = recode(site, "Seafan Valley" = "Sea Fan Valley")
  )

gee_clean <- gee_currents |>
  clean_name() |>
  mutate(
    island = str_squish(island),
    site   = str_squish(str_to_title(site)),
    site   = recode(site, "Seafan Valley" = "Sea Fan Valley")
  ) |>
  select(island, site, hycom_current_speed = mean)
```

```{r inspect}
dive_clean
transect_clean
nutrients_clean
gee_clean
```


#Summarising colony morphometrics

Summarising them per site by finding the mean and standard error

```{r}
colony_site <- dive_clean |>
  filter(!is.na(height)) |>
  group_by(island, site) |>
  summarise(
    n_colonies  = n(),
    mean_height = mean(height, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_height   = sd(height, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_width  = mean(width, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_depth  = mean(depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(colony_site)
```
#Summarising lab nutrients and chl_a

summarised by site, calculating the mean and standard error

```{r}
nutrients_site <- nutrients_clean |>
  group_by(island, site) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(silicate, phosphate, nitrate, chl_a),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        se   = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.x)))
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename(
    chl_a_lab_mean = chl_a_mean,
    chl_a_lab_se   = chl_a_se
  )
```


#Joining all tables in one master_site dataset

```{r}
master_site <- transect_clean |>
  left_join(colony_site, by = c("island", "site")) |>
  left_join(nutrients_site, by = c("island", "site")) |>
  left_join(gee_clean, by = c("island", "site"))

master_site
```


#Visualising

```{r plots}
# Plot 1: Mean colony height (+/- SE) across surveyed sites
p1 <- colony_site |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(site, mean_height), y = mean_height, fill = island)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_height - se_height, ymax = mean_height + se_height),
    width = 0.25
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Site",
    y = "Mean Colony Height (cm ± SE)",
    title = "Gorgonian Colony Height Across Surveyed Reef Sites",
    fill = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p1
ggsave(here::here("output/fig1_colony_height_by_site.png"), p1, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Plot 2: Gorgonian density vs. water-column silicate
p2 <- ggplot(master_site, aes(x = silicate_mean, y = avg_gorgonian_density, color = island)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean Silicate (µM)",
    y = "Mean Gorgonian Density (colonies/m²)",
    title = "Gorgonian Density vs. Water-Column Silicate",
    color = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p2
ggsave(here::here("output/fig2_density_vs_silicate.png"), p2, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Plot 3: Gorgonian density vs. satellite HYCOM current speed (GEE)
p3 <- master_site |>
  filter(!is.na(hycom_current_speed)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hycom_current_speed, y = avg_gorgonian_density, color = island)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean HYCOM Surface Current Speed (Apr–Jun 2024)",
    y = "Mean Gorgonian Density (colonies/m²)",
    title = "Gorgonian Density vs. Regional Ocean Current Speed (GEE)",
    color = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p3
ggsave(here::here("output/fig3_density_vs_current.png"), p3, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Plot 4: Colony Height vs. Width across measured colonies
p_morph <- dive_clean |>
  filter(!is.na(height), !is.na(width)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = width, y = height, color = island, shape = gorgonian_species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Colony Width (cm)",
    y = "Colony Height (cm)",
    title = "Gorgonian Morphometrics Across Mauritius and Rodrigues",
    color = "Island",
    shape = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p_morph
ggsave(here::here("output/fig_morphometrics_scatter.png"), p_morph, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Plot 5: Gorgonian Density across ALL 11 surveyed sites (ordered by density)
p_all_sites <- master_site |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(site, avg_gorgonian_density), y = avg_gorgonian_density, color = island)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = reorder(site, avg_gorgonian_density), y = 0, yend = avg_gorgonian_density),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Surveyed Site (All 11 Sites)",
    y = "Mean Gorgonian Density (colonies/m²)",
    title = "Gorgonian Density Across All Surveyed Sites",
    subtitle = "Includes zero-density Rodrigues sites to show full spatial baseline",
    color = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p_all_sites
ggsave(here::here("output/fig_all_sites_density.png"), p_all_sites, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Plot 6: Site-by-Site Reef Composition: Gorgonian Density vs. Total Coral Cover (all 11 sites)
p_composition <- master_site |>
  select(island, site, avg_gorgonian_density, total_coral_cover_pct) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(avg_gorgonian_density, total_coral_cover_pct),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric = recode(
      metric,
      "avg_gorgonian_density" = "Mean Gorgonian Density",
      "total_coral_cover_pct" = "Total Coral Cover (%)"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(site, value), y = value, fill = island)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Surveyed Site (All 11 Sites)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Gorgonian Density and Total Coral Cover Across All Sites",
    fill = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_composition
ggsave(here::here("output/fig_reef_composition_all_sites.png"), p_composition, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)


# Plot 7: Multi-Variable Water Chemistry Overview (Faceted across all 4 lab variables)
p_water_chem <- master_site |>
  select(island, site, silicate_mean, phosphate_mean, nitrate_mean, chl_a_lab_mean) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(silicate_mean, phosphate_mean, nitrate_mean, chl_a_lab_mean),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "mean_val"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(mean_val)) |>
  mutate(
    variable = recode(
      variable,
      "silicate_mean"  = "Silicate (µM)",
      "phosphate_mean" = "Phosphate (µM)",
      "nitrate_mean"   = "Nitrate (µM)",
      "chl_a_lab_mean" = "Lab Chl-a"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_val, y = reorder(site, mean_val), color = island)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = mean_val, yend = reorder(site, mean_val)),
    linewidth = 0.9,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Site Mean",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Water-Column Nutrients and Lab Chlorophyll-a Across Sites",
    color = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

p_water_chem
ggsave(here::here("output/fig_water_chemistry_overview.png"), p_water_chem, width = 10.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```
